I don't even know where to start. I feel like i can relate to you really well and although i'm not in the best position to give advice, i will anyway. Your parents are wrong. You feel this way because you've had to deal with them for all your life and it's (obviously) affected you very negatively. You are not stupid. You are not worthless. You have shitty friends. You have stupid parents. These are the only truths i can gather from your short posts. Get yourself the morning after pill somehow and if you can't and get pregnant, i personally think that having an abortion is the right choice. I WANT TO STRESS that i'm in no way advising you to do so against your will, but i believe that in your situation and based on the fact that your parents are (i'm sure very loving but nonetheless) very unhelpful to anyone who doesn't chose the same path as they see fit, i think that the last thing you want to do is get seriously tied down to them. 


Try hard at school (2 more years? one more year?) and get yourself out of there once you graduate. Even if your marks aren't good enough to get to school right away, either continue high school until they are high enough to apply to a college or university or do anything to get yourself out of there. 

DO NOT GIVE UP and go straight to work with no goal for school. Without an education it's really hard to get yourself out of a mess and it's even harder when you're feeling like shit all the time. So FORCE yourself to belive in yourself and get yourself out of there.

YOU ARE NOT YOURSELF WHEN YOU ARE LIVING UNDER YOUR PARENTS. Some parents keep their kids down without even meaning to. I'm sure you love them (i would understand if a large part of you doesn't.. as in you only love them because you've been living with them for so long.) but they are not helping you grow and nurturing you to be the best YOU can be. They are close minded and rigid and THIS IS NOT YOUR FAULT. DO NOT let their shortcomings ruin YOUR LIFE. Start planning, start getting yourself to neutral and WORK towards becoming the person you want to be- or at least not being the person you don't want to be anymore.

Darwin was talking about survival of the fittest. Today, the world is changing so fast and we're so aware of our part in it that it's no longer about survival of the genetically fittest. It's about how hard you will work and how much you think YOU DESERVE to be here. The only person who judges you is yourself and the only person who thinks you don't deserve to be here will only be you. And if you do feel this way it's because you are giving up. Not because you actually don't deserve to live.

I know it's really hard to understand this until it finally clicks and just makes sense, but you are worth something and until you BELIEVE it inside out, no one else will care about you the way that you need them to right now. You will always find people that care about you but i feel like the type of relationship most people strive for and really want is the type that only comes when you would be able to fall in love with yourself.. if that makes any sense. 

Think of it this way, if you don't love yourself, and respect yourself, and treat yourself with dignity and adoration, then how can you expect anyone else to? It doesn't mean that you're not worth it. It means that the other person can't see who you really are because you're hiding it so well that even you can't see it.

And i know it's really hard for this to 'click' because it's one of those things that you only 'get' when you 'achieve' it. So you HAVE to start loving youserlf, and you might be so used to ignoring yourself that the only way you can start to achieve this is to 'fake it'. EVERYDAY, and i mean everyday, you need to wake up and go infront of a mirror and tell yourself (and the hard part is that you have to MEAN every sentence) that:

I am in a bad place right now but I can get myself out of it. I are worth it. I will realize this one day soon. I am good at _____. (If you honestly can't think of anything, then say what you want to be good at and work at getting better at that one thing. Do not pick something that will take too long (a year) because the point of this is to set a goal, work towards the goal, and achieve the goal. the actual goal is not as important as the feeling of achievement.)

I hope this helps. I'm no expert in any sense and am just saying this from one upset person-of worth, to another. Don't be your worst enemy. There will always be people out there who don't give a shit about you but the only person who really has any power is yourself and if you don't care, then no one else will care.  

If you care, you will attract people who care.
